G1201.strongs: a place of bondage, i.e. a dungeon

senses: a master, lord, correlative of δοῦλος, οἰκέτης: [[r:1TI.6.1|1Ti 6:1]], 2, [[r:2TI.2.21|2Ti 2:21]], [[r:TIT.2.9|Tit 2:9]], [[r:1PE.2.18|1Pe 2:18]]; as title of God, voc., δέσποτα (so usually in LXX), [[r:LUK.2.29|Luk 2:29]], [[r:ACT.4.24|Act 4:24]]; ὁ δ. = voc. δέσποτα (cf. B1., § 33, 4), [[r:REV.6.10|Rev 6:10]]; of Christ, [[r:2PE.2.1|2Pe 2:1]], Ju 4, R, txt. (but cf. mg.).† SYN.: κύριος (which see), implying limitation of authority and a more general relation than δ., which "denoted absolute ownership and uncontrolled power" (Thayer). (AS)

G1204.strongs: here; used also imperative hither!; and of time, hitherto

G1205.root: from [[w:G1204]] and an imperative form of εἶμι (to go)
senses: δεῦτε adv., as pl. of δεῦρο, 1. (b), which see, come on! come here! come!: with imperat., [[r:MAT.25.34|Mat 25:34 28:6]], [[r:JHN.4.29|Jhn 4:29 21:12]], [[r:REV.19.17|Rev 19:17]]; with subjc., [[r:MAT.21.38|Mat 21:38]], [[r:MRK.12.7|Mrk 12:7]]; before ὀπίσω, [[r:MAT.4.19|Mat 4:19]], [[r:MRK.1.17|Mrk 1:17]]; πρός, [[r:MAT.11.28|Mat 11:28]]; εἰς, [[r:MAT.22.4|Mat 22:4]], [[r:MRK.6.31|Mrk 6:31]].† (AS)

G1206.strongs: secondary, i.e. (specially) on the second day
senses: (δεύτερος), adj. with adverbial sense; on the second day: δευτεραῖοι ἤλθομεν, [[r:ACT.28.13|Act 28:13.]]† (AS)

G1208.strongs: (ordinal) second (in time, place, or rank; also adverb)
senses: δεῦτερος, -α, -ον, second in order, with or without idea of time: [[r:MAT.22.26|Mat 22:26, 39]], al.; θάνατος, [[r:REV.2.11|Rev 2:11 20:14 21:8]]; χάρις, [[r:2CO.1.15|2Co 1:15.]] In neut. as adv., secondly, a second time; opposite to πρῶτον: [[r:JHN.3.4|Jhn 3:4 21:16]], [[r:1CO.12.28|1Co 12:28]], [[r:REV.19.3|Rev 19:3]]; τὸ δ., [[r:2CO.13.2|2Co 13:2]], Ju 5; ἐν τ. δ., at the second time: [[r:ACT.7.13|Act 7:13]]; in later usage (as [[r:1MA.9.1|1Ma 9:1]]), ἐκ δ., [[r:MRK.14.72|Mrk 14:72]], [[r:JHN.9.24|Jhn 9:24]], [[r:ACT.11.9|Act 11:9]], [[r:HEB.9.28|Heb 9:28]]. (AS)

G1209.root: middle voice of a primary verb
G1209.strongs: to receive (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
senses: with accusative of thing(s), of taking or accepting what is offered: γράμματα, [[r:LUK.16.6|Luk 16:6]], 7; id. in different sense, [[r:ACT.28.21|Act 28:21]]; ποτήριον, [[r:LUK.22.17|Luk 22:17]]; παιδίον (εἰς τ. ἀγκάλας), [[r:LUK.2.28|Luk 2:28]]; περικεφαλαίαν, μάχαιραν, [[r:EPH.6.17|Eph 6:17]]; ἐπιστολάς, [[r:ACT.22.5|Act 22:5]]; τ. βασιλείαν τ. Θεοῦ, [[r:MRK.10.15|Mrk 10:15]], [[r:LUK.18.17|Luk 18:17]]; λογία ζῶντα, [[r:ACT.7.38|Act 7:38]]; εὐαγγέλιον, [[r:2CO.11.4|2Co 11:4]]; τ. χάριν τ. Θεοῦ, [[r:2CO.6.1|2Co 6:1]]; metaphorically, of mental acceptance, [[r:MAT.11.14|Mat 11:14]]; τ. λόγον, [[r:LUK.8.13|Luk 8:13]], [[r:ACT.8.14|Act 8:14 11:1 17:11]], [[r:1TH.1.6|1Th 1:6 2:13]], [[r:JAS.1.21|Jas 1:21]]; τὰ τ. πνεύματος, [[r:1CO.2.14|1Co 2:14]]; τ. παράκλησιν, [[r:2CO.8.17|2Co 8:17]]; τ. ἀγάπην τ. ἀληθείας, [[r:2TH.2.10|2Th 2:10.]]

with accusative of person(s), of receiving kindly or hospitably, [[r:MAT.10.14|Mat 10:14 40, 41]], [[r:MRK.6.11|Mrk 6:11]], [[r:LUK.9.5|Luk 9:5 53 10:8, 10]], [[r:JHN.4.45|Jhn 4:45]], [[r:2CO.7.15|2Co 7:15 11:16]], [[r:GAL.4.14|Gal 4:14]], [[r:COL.4.10|Col 4:10]], [[r:HEB.11.31|Heb 11:31]]; παιδίον, [[r:MAT.18.5|Mat 18:5]], [[r:MRK.9.37|Mrk 9:37]], [[r:LUK.9.48|Luk 9:48]]; εἰς οἴκους, σκηνάς, [[r:LUK.16.4|Luk 16:4]], 9; δέξαι τ. πνεῦμά μου, [[r:ACT.7.59|Act 7:59]]; ὃν δεῖ οὐρανὸν δέασθαι, [[r:ACT.3.21|Act 3:21]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο, δια-, εἰσ-, ἐκ-, ἀπ-εκ-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, παρα-, προσ-, ὑπο-δέχομαι; Cremer, 174).† (AS)

G1210.strongs: to bind (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
G1210.kjv: bind, be in bonds, knit, tie, wind
senses: to tie, bind, fasten; (1) with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς δεσμάς, [[r:MAT.13.30|Mat 13:30]]; of an ass, [[r:MAT.21.2|Mat 21:2]], [[r:MRK.11.2|Mrk 11:2]], 4 [[r:LUK.19.30|Luk 19:30]]. (2) with accusative of person(s), of swathing a dead body, ὀθονίοις, [[r:JHN.19.40|Jhn 19:40]]; δεδομένος τ. πόδας... κειρίαις (Bl., §34, 6; Kühner 3, iii, 125), [[r:JHN.11.44|Jhn 11:44]]; of binding with chains, ἀγγέλους, [[r:REV.9.14|Rev 9:14]]; a demoniac, πέδαις κ. ἁλύσεσι, [[r:MRK.5.3|Mrk 5:3]], 4; captives, [[r:MAT.12.29|Mat 12:29 14:3 22:13 27:2]], [[r:MRK.3.27|Mrk 3:27 6:17 15:1, 7]], [[r:JHN.18.12|Jhn 18:12, 24]], [[r:ACT.9.2|Act 9:2, 14, 21, 21:11, 13 22:5, 29 24:27]], [[r:COL.4.3|Col 4:3]], [[r:REV.20.2|Rev 20:2]]; ἁλύσεσι, [[r:ACT.12.6|Act 12:6 21:33]]. Metaphorical, ὁ λόγος τ. Θεοῦ, [[r:2TI.2.9|2Ti 2:9]]; of Satan binding by disease (MM, see word), [[r:LUK.13.16|Luk 13:16]]; of constraint or obligation, [[r:ACT.20.22|Act 20:22]]; of the marriage bond, [[r:1CO.7.39|1Co 7:39]]; id. with dative of person(s), ἀνδρί, [[r:ROM.7.2|Rom 7:2]]; γυναικί, [[r:1CO.7.27|1Co 7:27]]; in Rabbinic lang. (Dalman, Words, 213f.), to forbid, declare forbidden, [[r:MAT.16.19|Mat 16:19 18:18]] (cf. κατα-, περι-, συν-, ὐπο-δέω; Cremer, 82). † (AS)

G1211.strongs: a particle of emphasis or explicitness; now, then, etc.
senses: δή consecutive co-ordinating particle with no exact equiv. in Eng., giving greater exactness and emphasis to the word or words to which it is attached; sometimes translatable as now therefore, then, verily, certainly.

With verbs: imperat., [[r:ACT.6.3|Act 6:3]] (WH, mg.) 13:2, [[r:1CO.6.20|1Co 6:20]]; hort. subjc., [[r:LUK.2.15|Luk 2:15]], [[r:ACT.15.36|Act 15:36]]; indic., δή που (Τ, δήπου, which see), [[r:HEB.2.16|Heb 2:16.]]
With pronouns: ὃ δή, now this is he who, [[r:MAT.13.23|Mat 13:23.]]† (AS)

clear to the mind, evident: [[r:MAT.26.73|Mat 26:73]]; δ. (sc. ἐστίν), before ὅτι, [[r:1CO.15.27|1Co 15:27]], [[r:GAL.3.11|Gal 3:11]].† SYN.: φανερός, with ref. to outward appearance, manifest as opposite to concealed; δ. with ref. to inner perception, evident, known, under­stood. (AS)

to make plain, declare: with accusative, [[r:1CO.3.13|1Co 3:13]], [[r:COL.1.8|Col 1:8]], [[r:HEB.9.8|Heb 9:8 12:27]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:2PE.1.14|2Pe 1:14]]; with dative of person(s), before περί (pass.), [[r:1CO.1.11|1Co 1:11]]; before εἰς, [[r:1PE.1.11|1Pe 1:11.]]† SYN.: ἐμφανίζω, to make manifest, render visible to the sight; δ. to render evident to the mind. (AS)
(perh. contracted from Δημήτριος), Demas, a companion of St. Paul: [[r:COL.4.14|Col 4:14]], Phm 24, [[r:2TI.4.10|2Ti 4:10]].† (AS)

G1215.strongs: to be a people-gatherer, i.e. to address a public assembly
senses: (δῆμος, ἀγορεύω, to speak in the assembly), to deliver an oration: [[r:ACT.12.21|Act 12:21.]]† (AS)

G1216.strongs: Demetrius, the name of an Ephesian and of a Christian

G1217.strongs: a worker for the people, i.e. mechanic (spoken of the Creator)
senses: Univ., an author, builder, maker; the maker of the world (Xen., Mem., I, 4, 9, al.), [[r:HEB.11.10|Heb 11:10.]]† SYN.: κτίστης, creator, τεχνίτης, craftsman, designer. In He, l.with, τ. has reference to the plan, δ. to its execution. (AS)

the common people, the people generally; esp. the people assembled: [[r:ACT.12.22|Act 12:22 17:5 19:30 33]]. † SYN.: λαός, the people at large: δ., the people as a body politic; opposite to δ. is ὄχλος, the unorganized multitude. ἔθνος, in sing., means in NT as in Gk. writers generally, a nation, but in pl. denotes the rest of mankind apart from the Jews: Gentiles. λ. also, rare in cl. (Att... λεώς), is frequently in LXX and NT, and usually limited to the chosen people, Israel (cf. Cl. Rev., i, 42 f.; Cremer, 689). (AS)

G1219.strongs: public; (feminine singular dative case as adverb) in public
senses: (δῆμος), belonging to the people, public: [[r:ACT.5.18|Act 5:18]]; dative fem. used adverbially (cl.);
at the public expense, by public consent;

the Lat. denarius, a Roman coin, nearly equal to the δραχμή, which see: [[r:MAT.18.28|Mat 18:28 20:2, 9, 13 22:19]], [[r:MRK.6.37|Mrk 6:37 12:15 14:5]], [[r:LUK.7.41|Luk 7:41 10:35 20:24]], [[r:JHN.6.7|Jhn 6:7 12:5]], [[r:REV.6.6|Rev 6:6]]; τὸ ἀνὰ δ., [[r:MAT.20.10|Mat 20:10.]]† (AS)

G1223.forms: διά (before a vowel δ᾽, exc. [[r:ROM.8.10|Rom 8:10]], [[r:2CO.5.7|2Co 5:7]], and in (Proper name)s; Tdf., Pr., 94)
G1223.root: a primary preposition denoting the channel of an act
G1223.strongs: through (in very wide applications, local, causal, or occasional)
G1223.kjv: after, always, among, at, to avoid, because of (that), briefly, by, for (cause) … fore, from, in, by occasion of, of, by reason of, for sake, that, thereby, therefore, X though, through(-out), to, wherefore, with (-in)
senses: prep. with genitive, accusative, as in cl.;

of Place, after verbs of motion or action: [[r:MAT.2.12|Mat 2:12 12:43]], [[r:MRK.2.23|Mrk 2:23]], [[r:LUK.4.30|Luk 4:30]], [[r:JHN.4.4|Jhn 4:4]], [[r:2CO.11.33|2Co 11:33]], al.; σώζεσθαι (διας-) δ. πυρός, ὕδατος, [[r:1CO.3.15|1Co 3:15]], [[r:1PE.3.20|1Pe 3:20]]; βλέπειν δ. ἐσόπτρου, [[r:1CO.13.12|1Co 13:12]]; metaphorically, of a state or condition: [[r:ROM.14.20|Rom 14:20]], [[r:2CO.2.4|2Co 2:4 5:7]], 10; δ. γράμματος, ἀκροβυστίας (Lft., Notes, 263, 279), [[r:ROM.2.27|Rom 2:27 4:11]]; δι ̓ὑπομενῆς, [[r:ROM.8.25|Rom 8:25.]]

Of the Means or Instrument; (1) of the efficient cause (regarded also as the instrument): of God, [[r:ROM.11.36|Rom 11:36]], [[r:1CO.1.9|1Co 1:9]], [[r:GAL.4.7|Gal 4:7]], [[r:HEB.2.10|Heb 2:10 7:21]]; of Christ, [[r:ROM.1.8|Rom 1:8 5:1, 17]], [[r:1CO.15.21|1Co 15:21]], [[r:1PE.4.11|1Pe 4:11]], al.; δ. τ. ὑμῶν δεήσεως, [[r:ROM.1.12|Rom 1:12]], [[r:2CO.1.4|2Co 1:4]], [[r:GAL.4.23|Gal 4:23]], al.; (2) of the agent, instrument or means;

with genitive of thing(s) (where often the simple dative is used in cl.; Jannaris, Gr., 375), [[r:JHN.11.4|Jhn 11:4]], [[r:ACT.5.12|Act 5:12]]; δ. τ. πίστεως, [[r:ROM.3.30|Rom 3:30]]; δ. λόγου θεοῦ, [[r:1PE.1.23|1Pe 1:23]]; δ. παραβολῆς, [[r:LUK.8.4|Luk 8:4]]; δουλεύειν δ. τ. ἀγάπης, [[r:GAL.5.13|Gal 5:13]]; δ. ἐπαγγελίας, [[r:GAL.3.18|Gal 3:18]],
rarely, as with genitive, through (Hom), δ. μέσον Σαμαρίας (ICC, in l.; Bl., §42, 1; Robertson, Gr., 581), [[r:LUK.17.11|Luk 17:11.]]
by reason of, because of, for the sake of;

with accusative of thing(s), δ. φθόνον, [[r:MAT.27.18|Mat 27:18]], [[r:MRK.15.10|Mrk 15:10]]; δ. φόβον, [[r:JHN.7.13|Jhn 7:13 20:19]]; δ. ἀγάπην, [[r:EPH.2.4|Eph 2:4]]; δ. τοῦτο, freq., for this cause, therefore, [[r:MAT.6.25|Mat 6:25]], [[r:MRK.6.14|Mrk 6:14]], [[r:LUK.11.49|Luk 11:49]], [[r:JHN.6.65|Jhn 6:65]], al.; id. before ὅτι, [[r:JHN.5.16|Jhn 5:16 10:17]], al.; δ. τί, why, [[r:MAT.9.11|Mat 9:11, 14]] [[r:MRK.2.18|Mrk 2:18]], [[r:JHN.7.45|Jhn 7:45]], al.; δ. τό, with inf., [[r:MRK.5.4|Mrk 5:4]], [[r:LUK.9.7|Luk 9:7]], [[r:JAS.4.2|Jas 4:2]].

In composition, (1) through, as in διαβαίνω; (2) of separation, asunder, as in διασπάω; (3) of distribution, abroad, as in διαγγέλλω; (4) of transition, as διαλλάσσω; (5) of "perfective" action (M, Pr., 112f., 115f.), as διαφύγω, διακαθαρίζω. (AS)

G1226.root: middle voice of a compound of [[w:G1223]] and [[w:G0950]]
G1226.strongs: to confirm thoroughly (by words), i.e. asseverate

G1227.strongs: to look through, i.e. recover full vision
senses: to see clearly: [[r:MAT.7.5|Mat 7:5]], [[r:MRK.8.25|Mrk 8:25]], [[r:LUK.6.42|Luk 6:42]] (cf. διάβλεψις, Aq., [[r:ISA.61.1|Isa 61:1]], for LXX ἀνάβ-).† (AS)
(διαβάλλω, which see) slanderous, accusing falsely. As subst., ὁ, ἡ, δ.;
generally (of. Es, ll. with), a slanderer, false accuser: [[r:1TI.3.6|1Ti 3:6]], 7 (CGT, in l., but see infr.) 3:11, [[r:2TI.3.3|2Ti 3:3]], [[r:TIT.2.3|Tit 2:3]];

G1230.kjv: X after, be past, be spent
senses: to go through, to pass, e.g. τ. νύκτα; absol., to live.
Of time, to intervene, elapse: ptcp., with ἡμερῶν τινῶν, [[r:ACT.25.13|Act 25:13]]; ἱκανοῦ χρόνου, [[r:ACT.27.9|ib 27:9]]; τ. σαβάτου, [[r:MRK.16.1|Mrk 16:1.]]† (AS)

G1231.strongs: to know thoroughly, i.e. ascertain exactly
senses: As Athen. law-term, to determine: τὰ καθ᾽ ὑμᾶς, your case, [[r:ACT.24.22|Act 24:22]] (Cremer, 673).† (AS)
δια-γογγύζω of a number, to murmur or mutter among themselves: [[r:LUK.15.2|Luk 15:2 19:7]].† (AS)
Of time, to pass: βίον, [[r:1TI.2.2|1Ti 2:2]]; absol., to live, before ἐν, [[r:TIT.3.3|Tit 3:3.]]† (AS)

G1237.strongs: to receive in turn, i.e. (figuratively) succeed to
senses: δια-δέχομαι to receive through another, receive in turn: [[r:ACT.7.45|Act 7:45]] (RV, in their turn; see Field, Notes, 116).† (AS)

(διαδέω, to bind round), the band round the τιάρα of a Persian king; a diadem, the badge of royalty: [[r:REV.12.3|Rev 12:3 13:1 19:12]].† SYN.: στέφανος, the badge of "victory, of valour, of nuptial joy, of festal gladness " (but see M, Th., i, 219; cf. DB, i, 530, 604). (AS)

G1239.strongs: to give throughout a crowd, i.e. deal out; also to deliver over (as to a successor)

senses: διά-δοχος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ (διαδέχομαι), a successor: [[r:ACT.24.27|Act 24:27]] (for usage in LXX and π. in sense of court official, see Deiss., BS, 115).† (AS)
δια-ζώννυμι, (also -ννύω) to gird round: ἑαυτόν, [[r:JHN.13.4|Jhn 13:4]]; pass., [[r:JHN.13.5|ib 13:5]]; mid., to gird oneself with: with accusative, [[r:JHN.21.7|Jhn 21:7.]]† (AS)

G1242.strongs: properly, a disposition, i.e. (specially) a contract (especially a devisory will)
senses: as usually in cl., a disposition, testament, will (Plat., al.): [[r:GAL.3.15|Gal 3:15]] (R, mg., but see Lft., in l.), [[r:HEB.9.16|Heb 9:16, 17]] (R, txt.; MM, Exp., xi; Milligan, NTD, 75; Abbott, Essays, 107; Deiss., LAE, 341; but see infr.).

As in LXX (for בְּרִית) = cl. συνθήκη, a convention, arrangement, covenant (exc. in the disputed cases mentioned above, always between God and man, "perhaps with the feeling that the δια- compound was more suitable than the συν- for a covenant with God---συνθ. might suggest equal terms," MM, Exp., l.with): [[r:GAL.3.15|Gal 3:15]] (R, txt., but see supr., and cf. Thayer, see word), [[r:HEB.9.16|Heb 9:16, 17]] (R, mg., Westc., in l.; Hatch, Essays, 47; but see supr.), [[r:MAT.26.28|Mat 26:28]], [[r:MRK.14.24|Mrk 14:24]], [[r:LUK.1.72|Luk 1:72]], [[r:ACT.3.25|Act 3:25 7:8]], [[r:ROM.11.27|Rom 11:27]]" (LXX), [[r:2CO.3.14|2Co 3:14]], [[r:GAL.3.17|Gal 3:17]], [[r:HEB.7.22|Heb 7:22 8:6]], ib. 9, 10" (LXX) 9:4, 15-17 20" (LXX) 10:16 (LXX), 29 12:24 13:20, [[r:REV.11.19|Rev 11:19]]; καινὴ δ., [[r:MAT.26.28|Mat 26:28]], and [[r:MRK.14.24|Mrk 14:24]] (R, mg.), [[r:LUK.22.20|Luk 22:20]], [[r:1CO.11.25|1Co 11:25]], [[r:2CO.3.6|2Co 3:6]], [[r:HEB.8.8|Heb 8:8]]" (LXX) 9:15; pl. [[r:ROM.9.4|Rom 9:4]], [[r:GAL.4.24|Gal 4:24]], [[r:EPH.2.12|Eph 2:12]].† (AS)
to distribute: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.15.12|Luk 15:12]], [[r:1CO.12.11|1Co 12:11]].† (AS)

G1246.root: middle voice from [[w:G1223]] and a compound of [[w:G2596]] and [[w:G1651]]

G1247.strongs: to be an attendant, i.e. wait upon (menially or as a host, friend, or (figuratively) teacher); technically, to act as a Christian deacon
G1247.kjv: (ad-)minister (unto), serve, use the office of a deacon
senses: generally, to minister, serre, wait upon, especially at table, to do one a service, cure for one's needs: absol., [[r:MAT.20.28|Mat 20:28]], [[r:MRK.10.45|Mrk 10:45]], [[r:LUK.10.40|Luk 10:40 22:26, 27]], [[r:JHN.12.2|Jhn 12:2]], [[r:1PE.4.11|1Pe 4:11]]; ὅσα διηκόνησεν, [[r:2TI.1.18|2Ti 1:18]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.4.11|Mat 4:11 8:15 25:44 27:55]], [[r:MRK.1.13|Mrk 1:13, 31 15:41]], [[r:LUK.4.39|Luk 4:39 8:3 12:37 17:8]], [[r:JHN.12.26|Jhn 12:26]], [[r:ACT.6.2|Act 6:2 19:22]], [[r:ROM.15.25|Rom 15:25]], Phm 13, [[r:HEB.6.10|Heb 6:10]].
C. accusative of thing(s), to minister, supply, supply by ministration: [[r:1PE.1.12|1Pe 1:12 4:10]]; pass., [[r:2CO.3.3|2Co 3:3 8:19, 20]].† SYN.: λειτουργέω, which see (Cremer, 179). (AS)

G1248.strongs: attendance (as a servant, etc.); figuratively (eleemosynary) aid, (official) service (especially of the Christian teacher, or technically of the diaconate)
senses: (διάκονος), the office and work of a διάκονος, service, ministry;

spec. of religious ministration, and the exercise of ministerial functions in the Church: [[r:ACT.1.17|Act 1:17, 25 6:1, 4 11:29 12:25 20:24; 21:19]], [[r:ROM.11.13|Rom 11:13 12:7 15:31]], [[r:1CO.16.15|1Co 16:15]], [[r:2CO.4.1|2Co 4:1 6:3 8:4 9:1, 13]], [[r:EPH.4.12|Eph 4:12]], [[r:COL.4.17|Col 4:17]], [[r:1TI.1.12|1Ti 1:12]], [[r:2TI.4.5|2Ti 4:5, 11]], [[r:HEB.1.14|Heb 1:14]], [[r:REV.2.19|Rev 2:19]]; δ. τ. θανάτου, [[r:2CO.3.7|2Co 3:7]]; τ. πνεύματος, [[r:2CO.3.8|2Co 3:8]]; τ. κατακρίσεως, τ, δικαιοσύνης, [[r:2CO.3.9|2Co 3:9]]; τ. καταλλαγῆς, [[r:2CO.5.18|2Co 5:18]]; τ. λειτουργίας, [[r:2CO.9.12|2Co 9:12]]; with obj. genitive, τὴν ὑμῶν δ., [[r:2CO.11.8|ib 11:8]]; pl., [[r:1CO.12.5|1Co 12:5.]]† (AS)

G1249.root: probably from an obsolete διάκω (to run on errands; compare [[w:G1377]])
G1249.strongs: an attendant, i.e. (genitive case) a waiter (at table or in other menial duties); specially, a Christian teacher and pastor (technically, a deacon or deaconess)
senses: As technical term for Church officer (so in pre-Christian times, see M, Th., I, 32), a deacon: [[r:PHP.1.1|Php 1:1]], [[r:1TI.3.8|1Ti 3:8, 12]]; fem. (cf. Eccl. διακονίσσα), [[r:ROM.16.1|Rom 16:1]] (cf. [[r:1TI.3.11|1Ti 3:11]], and CGT, in l., also M, Th., l.with).† SYN.: δοῦλος, bondman; θεράπων, servant acting voluntarily; ὑπηρέτης, servant, attendant, by etymol. suggesting subordination. All these imply relation to a person, in distinction from which δ. represents rather the servant in relation to his work. Cf. also λειτουργός, a public servant, in which the idea of service to the community is prominent; οἰκέτης, a house servant. (AS)

G1251.strongs: to hear throughout, i.e. patiently listen (to a prisoner's plea)
senses: δι-ακούω to hear through, hear fully; technically, to hear judicially (as De, l.with; of. Deiss., BS, 230): [[r:ACT.23.35|Act 23:35.]]† (AS)

G1252.strongs: to separate thoroughly, i.e. (literally and reflexively) to withdraw from, or (by implication) oppose; figuratively, to discriminate (by implication, decide), or (reflexively) hesitate
G1252.kjv: contend, make (to) differ(-ence), discern, doubt, judge, be partial, stagger, waver
senses: to separate, hence, to distinguish, discriminate, discern: μηδὲν δ., [[r:ACT.11.12|Act 11:12]]; οὐδὲν δ. μεταξύ, [[r:ACT.15.9|Act 15:9]]; σε, [[r:1CO.4.7|1Co 4:7]]; τὸ σῶμα, [[r:1CO.11.29|1Co 11:29.]]
to settle, decide, judge, arbitrate: [[r:MAT.16.3|Mat 16:3]], [[r:1CO.6.5|1Co 6:5 11:29]] (ICC, in l.), ib. 31 14:29. Mid, and pass.;
to get a decision, contend, dispute: before πρός, [[r:ACT.11.2|Act 11:2]]; with dative (but see ICC, in l.), Ju 9; absol., Ju 22 (R,mg.).

Hellenistic (NT and Eccl., but not LXX), to be divided in one's mind, to hesitate, doubt: [[r:MAT.21.21|Mat 21:21]] [[r:ROM.14.23|Rom 14:23]], [[r:JAS.1.6|Jas 1:6]]; ἐν ἐαυτῷ, [[r:JAS.2.4|Jas 2:4]]; ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, [[r:MRK.11.23|Mrk 11:23]]; μηδὲν δ., [[r:ACT.10.20|Act 10:20]]; δ. τ. ἀπιστίᾳ, [[r:ROM.4.20|Rom 4:20]], Ju 22 (R, txt.).† (AS)

G1254.strongs: to hinder altogether, i.e. utterly prohibit

G1255.strongs: to talk throughout a company, i.e. converse or (genitive case) publish

G1256.strongs: to say thoroughly, i.e. discuss (in argument or exhortation)
senses: δια-λέγομαι (mid. of διαλέγω, to pick out, distinguish, as depon.), to converse with, discourse (see Cl. Rev., i, 45), discuss, argue: [[r:ACT.18.4|Act 18:4 19:8,9 20:9]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.17.17|Act 17:17 18:19 20:7]], [[r:HEB.12.5|Heb 12:5]]; before πρός, [[r:MRK.9.34|Mrk 9:34]], [[r:ACT.17.17|Act 17:17 24:12]]; περί [[r:ACT.24.25|Act 24:25]], Ju 9; ἀπὸ τ. γραφῶν, [[r:ACT.17.2|Act 17:2.]]† (AS)

G1257.strongs: to leave off in the middle, i.e. intermit
senses: δια-λείπω to intermit, leave off for a time: [[r:LUK.7.45|Luk 7:45.]]† (AS)
As in Polyb. and later writers, the language or dialect of a particular country or district: [[r:ACT.1.19|Act 1:19 2:6, 8 21:40 22:2 26:14]].† (AS)

G1259.strongs: to change thoroughly, i.e. (mentally) to conciliate
senses: to change enmity for friendship, to reconcile: pass., with dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.5.24|Mat 5:24.]] "The word denotes mutual concession after mutual hostility, an idea absent from καταλλ-," which see (Lft., Notes, 288; cf. Deiss., LAE, 178.15; Cremer, 91, 632).† (AS)

G1260.strongs: to reckon thoroughly, i.e. (genitive case) to deliberate (by reflection or discussion)
G1260.kjv: cast in mind, consider, dispute, muse, reason, think
senses: to consider, reason (Isocr.): [[r:LUK.1.29|Luk 1:29 5:21]]; ἐν τ. καρδία, [[r:MRK.2.6|Mrk 2:6]], 8, [[r:LUK.5.22|Luk 5:22]]; περί [[r:LUK.3.15|Luk 3:15]]; ἐν ἑαυτῷ (-οῖς), [[r:MAT.16.7|Mat 16:7-8]], [[r:MRK.2.8|Mrk 2:8]], [[r:LUK.12.17|Luk 12:17]]; πρὸς ἑ., [[r:MRK.9.33|Mrk 9:33 11:31]], [[r:LUK.20.14|Luk 20:14]]; παρ᾽ ἑ., [[r:MAT.21.25|Mat 21:25]] (ἐν ἑ., T, WH, mg.); πρὸς ἀλλήλους, [[r:MRK.8.16|Mrk 8:16]]; ὅτι, [[r:MRK.8.17|Mrk 8:17]], [[r:JHN.11.50|Jhn 11:50]], Rec. (DB, i, 611; Cremer, 400).† (AS)

G1261.strongs: discussion, i.e. (internal) consideration (by implication, purpose), or (external) debate
senses: δια-λογισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (διαλογίζομαι) a thought, reasoning, inward questioning: [[r:MAT.15.19|Mat 15:19]], [[r:MRK.7.21|Mrk 7:21]], [[r:LUK.2.35|Luk 2:35 5:22 6:8 9:46, 47 24:38]], [[r:ROM.1.21|Rom 1:21 14:1]], [[r:1CO.3.20|1Co 3:20]]" (LXX), [[r:PHP.2.14|Php 2:14]]; κριταὶ δ. πονηρῶν, genitive of qual. (cf. [[r:PRO.12.5|Pro 12:5]]), [[r:JAS.2.4|Jas 2:4]]; χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ δ. (where perh. δ., like מְזִמָּה, in [[r:PSA.139.20|Ps 138(139):20]], al., implies evil intention), [[r:1TI.2.8|1Ti 2:8]] (see Hort, in l.; cf. Cremer, 400).† (AS)
δια-λύω to part asunder, dissolve; of an assembly, pass., to disperse: [[r:ACT.5.36|Act 5:36.]]† (AS)

G1263.strongs: to attest or protest earnestly, or (by implication) hortatively
senses: δια-μαρτύρομαι, depon., of Ionic origin, intensive of the simple μαρτύρομαι, which see, solemnly to protest: [[r:LUK.16.28|Luk 16:28]], [[r:ACT.2.40|Act 2:40 8:25 10:42 18:5 20:21, 23, 24 23:11 28:23]], [[r:1TH.4.6|1Th 4:6]], [[r:HEB.2.6|Heb 2:6]]; in adjuration, before ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, [[r:1TI.5.21|1Ti 5:21]], [[r:2TI.2.14|2Ti 2:14 4:1]] (Cremer, 415).† (AS)

G1265.strongs: to stay constantly (in being or relation)

G1266.strongs: to partition thoroughly (literally in distribution, figuratively in dissension)
senses: to distribute: with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.2.45|Act 2:45]]; before εἰς, [[r:LUK.22.17|Luk 22:17]], pass., [[r:ACT.2.3|Act 2:3.]] Mid. to distribute among themselves: [[r:MAT.27.35|Mat 27:35]], [[r:MRK.15.24|Mrk 15:24]], [[r:LUK.23.34|Luk 23:34]]; with redundant ἑαυτοῖς, [[r:JHN.19.24|Jhn 19:24]] (LXX) (see M, Pr., 157).
to divide, separate: pass., before ἐπί, with accusative, [[r:LUK.11.17|Luk 11:17-18]]; ἐπί, with dative, [[r:LUK.12.52|Luk 12:52-53.]]† (AS)

G1268.strongs: to distribute, i.e. (of information) to disseminate
senses: δια-νέμω to distribute, divide: pass., to be spread about, [[r:ACT.4.17|Act 4:17.]]† (AS)

G1269.strongs: to nod (or express by signs) across an intervening space
senses: δια-νεύω to wink at, nod to, beckon to: [[r:LUK.1.22|Luk 1:22.]]† (AS)

G1270.strongs: something thought through, i.e. a sentiment

G1271.strongs: deep thought, properly, the faculty (mind or its disposition), by implication, its exercise

G1272.strongs: to open thoroughly, literally (as a first-born) or figuratively (to expound)
senses: δι-αν-οίγω to open up completely, to open: [[r:LUK.2.23|Luk 2:23]] (LXX); pass., [[r:MRK.7.34|Mrk 7:34]], [[r:ACT.7.56|Act 7:56]]. Metaphorical, δ. τ. νοῦν, [[r:LUK.24.45|Luk 24:45]], τ. καρδίαν, [[r:ACT.16.14|Act 16:14]], pass., οἱ ὀφθαλμοί, [[r:LUK.24.31|Luk 24:31]]; of explaining, τ. γραφάς, [[r:LUK.24.32|Luk 24:32]], [[r:ACT.17.3|Act 17:3]].† (AS)

G1273.strongs: to sit up the whole night
senses: δια-νυκτερεύω (cf. διημερεύω, to pass the day) to pass the night: before ἐν τ. προσευχῆ, [[r:LUK.6.12|Luk 6:12.]]† (AS)
In late writers (Xen., al., Clem., I ad Cor., xxv, 3), to continue: Ac, l.with (Field, Notes, 134f.).† (AS)

G1276.root: from [[w:G1223]] and a derivative of the base of [[w:G4008]]
senses: δια-περάω, -ῶ to pass over, cross over: [[r:MAT.9.1|Mat 9:1]]; before ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, [[r:MAT.14.34|Mat 14:34]], [[r:MRK.6.53|Mrk 6:53]]; εἰς, [[r:MRK.5.21|Mrk 5:21]], [[r:ACT.21.2|Act 21:2]]; πρὸς ἡμᾶς, [[r:LUK.16.28|Luk 16:28.]]† (AS)
to sail across , Thuc.; εἰς Αἴγιναν (Aristophanes Comicus): metaphorically, δ. βίον to make life's voyage , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

G1278.strongs: to toil through, i.e. (passively) be worried
senses: δια-πονέω, -ῶ to work out with labour. Pass., to be worn out, sore troubled: [[r:MRK.14.4|Mrk 14:4]] (WH, mg.), [[r:ACT.4.2|Act 4:2 16:18]].† (AS)

G1279.kjv: go through, journey in, pass by
senses: δια-πορεύω to carry over. Pass., to pass across, journey through: absol., [[r:LUK.18.36|Luk 18:36]], [[r:ROM.15.24|Rom 15:24]]; before κατὰ πόλεις κ. κώμας, [[r:LUK.13.22|Luk 13:22]]; διά, with genitive, [[r:MRK.2.23|Mrk 2:23]], [[r:LUK.6.1|Luk 6:1]] (cf. [[r:PRO.9.12|Pro 9:12]] with, [[r:WIS.3.1|Wis 3:1]]); with accusative, [[r:ACT.16.4|Act 16:4.]]† (AS)

δι-απορέω, -ῶ to be quite at a loss, be in great perplexity: absol., [[r:ACT.2.12|Act 2:12]]; before διὰ τό, with inf., [[r:LUK.9.7|Luk 9:7]]; περί, [[r:ACT.5.24|Act 5:24]]; ἐν ἑαυτῷ, [[r:ACT.10.17|Act 10:17.]]† (AS)

G1281.strongs: to thoroughly occupy oneself, i.e. (transitively and by implication) to earn in business
senses: In late writers (Dion. Hal.), to gain by trading: [[r:LUK.19.15|Luk 19:15.]]† (AS)

G1282.strongs: to saw asunder, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate
senses: δια-πρίω to saw asunder. Pass., metaphorically (vernacular?), EV, cut to the heart: [[r:ACT.5.33|Act 5:33]]; before τ. καρδίαις αὐτῶν, [[r:ACT.7.54|Act 7:54.]]† (AS)

δια-ρήσσω (so WH, exc. Ac, l.with), δια-ρρήσσω (poetic and late form of διαρρήγνυμι), to break asunder, burst, rend: δεσμά, [[r:LUK.8.29|Luk 8:29]]; pass., δίκτυα, [[r:LUK.5.6|Luk 5:6]]; ἱμάτια, χιτῶνας, in grief or anger (as [[r:GEN.37.29|Gen 37:29]], al.), [[r:MAT.26.65|Mat 26:65]], [[r:ACT.14.14|Act 14:14]], [[r:MRK.14.63|Mrk 14:63]].† (AS)
δια-σαφέω, -ῶ (σαφής, clear), to make clear, explain fully: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.13.26|Mat 13:26 18:31]].† (AS)

G1286.strongs: to shake thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) to intimidate

G1287.strongs: to dissipate, i.e. (genitive case) to rout or separate; specially, to winnow; figuratively, to squander
senses: δια-σκορπίζω to scatter abroad, disperse: of sheep, [[r:MAT.26.31|Mat 26:31]] = [[r:MRK.14.27|Mrk 14:27]]" (LXX); of persons, [[r:LUK.1.51|Luk 1:51]], [[r:ACT.5.37|Act 5:37]], opposite to συνάγω, [[r:JHN.11.52|Jhn 11:52]]; of winnowing grain, [[r:MAT.25.24|Mat 25:24, 26]]; metaphorically, of property, to squander, waste: [[r:LUK.15.13|Luk 15:13 16:1]].† (AS)

G1288.strongs: to draw apart, i.e. sever or dismember
senses: δια-σπάω, -ῶ to break or tear asunder: pass., ἁλύσεις, [[r:MRK.5.4|Mrk 5:4]]; Παῦλος, [[r:ACT.23.10|Act 23:10.]]† (AS)

G1289.strongs: to sow throughout, i.e. (figuratively) distribute in foreign lands

G1290.strongs: dispersion, i.e. (specially and concretely) the (converted) Israelite resident in Gentile countries
senses: δια-σπορά, -ᾶς, ἡ (διασπείρω), a dispersion: δ. τῶν Ἑλλήνων, [[r:JHN.7.35|Jhn 7:35]]; metaphorically, of Christians (DB, iii, 782 f.), [[r:JAS.1.1|Jas 1:1]], [[r:1PE.1.1|1Pe 1:1]] (see Hort, in ll).† (AS)

G1291.strongs: to set (oneself) apart (figuratively, distinguish), i.e. (by implication) to enjoin
senses: to command, charge expressly: pass., τὸ διαστελλόμενον, [[r:HEB.12.20|Heb 12:20.]] Mid., in late Gk. with same sense (so Ez, l.with; and al. in LXX; MM, see word); a. dative of person(s), [[r:MRK.8.15|Mrk 8:15]], [[r:ACT.15.24|Act 15:24]]; before ἵνα, [[r:MAT.16.20|Mat 16:20]], [[r:MRK.5.43|Mrk 5:43 7:36 9:9]].† (AS)

G1294.strongs: to distort, i.e. (figuratively) misinterpret, or (morally) corrupt
senses: δια-στρέφω to distort, twist; metaphorically, to distort, pervert: [[r:LUK.23.2|Luk 23:2]], [[r:ACT.13.8|Act 13:8, 10]]; διεστραμμένος, perverse: [[r:MAT.17.17|Mat 17:17]], [[r:LUK.9.41|Luk 9:41]], [[r:ACT.20.30|Act 20:30]], [[r:PHP.2.15|Php 2:15]].† (AS)

G1295.strongs: to save thoroughly, i.e. (by implication or analogy) to cure, preserve, rescue, etc.
G1295.kjv: bring safe, escape (safe), heal, make perfectly whole, save
senses: δια-σώζω to bring safely through a danger: [[r:LUK.7.3|Luk 7:3]], [[r:ACT.27.43|Act 27:43]]; before πρός, [[r:ACT.23.24|Act 23:24.]] Pass., to come safe through: [[r:ACT.28.1|Act 28:1]]; ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, [[r:ACT.27.44|Act 27:44]]; ἐκ τ. θαλάσσης, [[r:ACT.28.4|Act 28:4]]; δι᾽ ὕδατος, [[r:1PE.3.20|1Pe 3:20]]; of sickness, to recover: [[r:MAT.14.36|Mat 14:36.]]† (AS)
δια-ταγή, -ῆς, ἡ (διατάσσω), in late writers (Deiss., LAE, 86 ff.) for cl. διάταξις (WH., however, is found in LXX, [[r:PSA.119.91|Psa 119:91]], al.);

disposition (cf. διάταξις for צָבָא; Sm., 4Ki.23:4, [[r:JER.8.2|Jer 8:2 19:13]]); εἰς διαταγὰς ἀγγέλων, AV, by the disposition of angels (Alf., in l, Field, Notes, 116; but see infr.): [[r:ACT.7.53|Act 7:53]];
ordinance (C. I. 3465): [[r:ROM.13.2|Rom 13:2]], [[r:ACT.7.53|Act 7:53]], R, txt. (and see mg.; Page and EGT, in l; but also see supr.).† (AS)

G1298.strongs: to disturb wholly, i.e. agitate (with alarm)

G1299.strongs: to arrange thoroughly, i.e. (specially) institute, prescribe, etc.
G1299.kjv: appoint, command, give, (set in) order, ordain
senses: δια-τάσσω to charge, give orders to, appoint, arrange, ordain: with dative, [[r:MAT.11.1|Mat 11:1]], [[r:1CO.9.14|1Co 9:14 16:1]]; before inf., [[r:LUK.8.55|Luk 8:55]], [[r:ACT.18.2|Act 18:2]]. Mid., [[r:1CO.7.17|1Co 7:17]], [[r:ACT.20.13|Act 20:13]]; with accusative, [[r:1CO.11.34|1Co 11:34]]; with dative, [[r:TIT.1.5|Tit 1:5]]; before inf., [[r:ACT.7.44|Act 7:44 24:23]]. Pass., τὸ διατεταγμένον, [[r:LUK.3.13|Luk 3:13]], [[r:ACT.23.31|Act 23:31]]; τὰ διαταχθέντα, [[r:LUK.17.9|Luk 17:9-10]]; διαταγείς, [[r:GAL.3.19|Gal 3:19.]]† (AS)

G1207.strongs: second-first, i.e. (specially) a designation of the Sabbath immediately after the Paschal week (being the second after Passover day, and the first of the seven Sabbaths intervening before Pentecost)
senses: δευτερό-πρωτος, -ον second first (in what sense, there is no satisfactory explanation. The reading is prob. not original, see ICC, in l.; DCG, i, 411; ii, 541, 724): [[r:LUK.6.1|Luk 6:1]], WH, mg., R, mg.† (AS)

G1221.strongs: a particle of generalization; indeed, at any time
senses: δή-ποτε indef. adv. (also written δή ποτε), with generalizing force;
With adv. or relat., -soever: ᾦ δ., [[r:JHN.5.4|Jhn 5:4]] (L, οἱῳδηποτοῦν).† (AS)

G1222.strongs: a particle of asseveration; indeed doubtless
senses: δή-που (WH, δή που), indef. adv., mostly in sense of surely, of course, we know: [[r:HEB.2.16|Heb 2:16]] T (WH, δή που).† (AS)

G1275.root: from [[w:G1223]] and the genitive case of [[w:G3956]]
senses: δια-παντός, see διά, with genitive διά (before a vowel δ᾽, exc. [[r:ROM.8.10|Rom 8:10]], [[r:2CO.5.7|2Co 5:7]], and in (Proper name)s; Tdf., Pr., 94), prep. with genitive, accusative, as in cl.;

of Place, after verbs of motion or action: [[r:MAT.2.12|Mat 2:12 12:43]], [[r:MRK.2.23|Mrk 2:23]], [[r:LUK.4.30|Luk 4:30]], [[r:JHN.4.4|Jhn 4:4]], [[r:2CO.11.33|2Co 11:33]], al.; σώζεσθαι (διας-) δ. πυρός, ὕδατος, [[r:1CO.3.15|1Co 3:15]], [[r:1PE.3.20|1Pe 3:20]]; βλέπειν δ. ἐσόπτρου, [[r:1CO.13.12|1Co 13:12]]; metaphorically, of a state or condition: [[r:ROM.14.20|Rom 14:20]], [[r:2CO.2.4|2Co 2:4 5:7]], 10; δ. γράμματος, ἀκροβυστίας (Lft., Notes, 263, 279), [[r:ROM.2.27|Rom 2:27 4:11]]; δι ̓ὑπομενῆς, [[r:ROM.8.25|Rom 8:25.]]

Of the Means or Instrument; (1) of the efficient cause (regarded also as the instrument): of God, [[r:ROM.11.36|Rom 11:36]], [[r:1CO.1.9|1Co 1:9]], [[r:GAL.4.7|Gal 4:7]], [[r:HEB.2.10|Heb 2:10 7:21]]; of Christ, [[r:ROM.1.8|Rom 1:8 5:1, 17]], [[r:1CO.15.21|1Co 15:21]], [[r:1PE.4.11|1Pe 4:11]], al.; δ. τ. ὑμῶν δεήσεως, [[r:ROM.1.12|Rom 1:12]], [[r:2CO.1.4|2Co 1:4]], [[r:GAL.4.23|Gal 4:23]], al.; (2) of the agent, instrument or means;

with genitive of thing(s) (where often the simple dative is used in cl.; Jannaris, Gr., 375), [[r:JHN.11.4|Jhn 11:4]], [[r:ACT.5.12|Act 5:12]]; δ. τ. πίστεως, [[r:ROM.3.30|Rom 3:30]]; δ. λόγου θεοῦ, [[r:1PE.1.23|1Pe 1:23]]; δ. παραβολῆς, [[r:LUK.8.4|Luk 8:4]]; δουλεύειν δ. τ. ἀγάπης, [[r:GAL.5.13|Gal 5:13]]; δ. ἐπαγγελίας, [[r:GAL.3.18|Gal 3:18]],
rarely, as with genitive, through (Hom), δ. μέσον Σαμαρίας (ICC, in l.; Bl., §42, 1; Robertson, Gr., 581), [[r:LUK.17.11|Luk 17:11.]]
by reason of, because of, for the sake of;

with accusative of thing(s), δ. φθόνον, [[r:MAT.27.18|Mat 27:18]], [[r:MRK.15.10|Mrk 15:10]]; δ. φόβον, [[r:JHN.7.13|Jhn 7:13 20:19]]; δ. ἀγάπην, [[r:EPH.2.4|Eph 2:4]]; δ. τοῦτο, freq., for this cause, therefore, [[r:MAT.6.25|Mat 6:25]], [[r:MRK.6.14|Mrk 6:14]], [[r:LUK.11.49|Luk 11:49]], [[r:JHN.6.65|Jhn 6:65]], al.; id. before ὅτι, [[r:JHN.5.16|Jhn 5:16 10:17]], al.; δ. τί, why, [[r:MAT.9.11|Mat 9:11, 14]] [[r:MRK.2.18|Mrk 2:18]], [[r:JHN.7.45|Jhn 7:45]], al.; δ. τό, with inf., [[r:MRK.5.4|Mrk 5:4]], [[r:LUK.9.7|Luk 9:7]], [[r:JAS.4.2|Jas 4:2]].

In composition, (1) through, as in διαβαίνω; (2) of separation, asunder, as in διασπάω; (3) of distribution, abroad, as in διαγγέλλω; (4) of transition, as διαλλάσσω; (5) of "perfective" action (M, Pr., 112f., 115f.), as διαφύγω, διακαθαρίζω. (AS)
